properties.evidence: This asks about the ARCHIVAL copy while that one decides whether the export becomes the DURABLE copy, and the two answers are coupled. If durability moves to a gitignored autosave path, how often the committed copy is written becomes a free variable and option D stops fighting export-once-per-PR; if it does not, the committed copy is the only copy and committing it LESS often is unsafe. Option D is unjudgeable until that settles.
